title: Expenses component data
description: Shared expenses. Each expense is an e_<uuid> key and each settlement an s_<uuid> key; the value is a JSON-encoded string of $defs/expense or $defs/settlement, and '' deletes it (tombstone). Amounts are integer minor units (cents). Any member may add, edit or delete expenses. A settlement records that from paid to; only the creditor (to) records, edits or deletes it, so to must be your own public key.

v.description: Wire format version, written by the app. Absent means 1.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^e_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[.description: One expense, a JSON-encoded string of $defs/expense. Key e_<uuid>. '' deletes it. Any member may add, edit or delete. Example value: "{\"what\":\"Dinner\",\"payer\":\"<publicKey>\",\"amount\":4500}". Annotation only: '' and future non-JSON values are also stored here.

^s_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[.description: One settlement, a JSON-encoded string of $defs/settlement. Key s_<uuid>. '' deletes it. Only the creditor (to) may record, edit or delete it, so to must be your own public key. Example value: "{\"from\":\"<debtor publicKey>\",\"to\":\"<your publicKey>\",\"amount\":2000}". Annotation only: '' and future non-JSON values are also stored here.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

what.description: What the money was spent on. Example: "Dinner".

payer.description: Public key of the member who paid.

amount.description: Amount in integer minor units (cents). Example: 4500 is 45.00.

with.description: Public keys of the members who share the expense. Absent means all current members.

from.description: Public key of the member who paid back.

to.description: Public key of the member who received the money (the creditor).

amount.description: Amount in integer minor units (cents), at least 1. Example: 2000 is 20.00.
